title: GitTierTagger
description: Display GitTiers player rankings directly in Minecraft! See all tiers (Vanilla, Sword, UHC, SMP, Mace, Axe, Pot, NethOP) next to player names in-game with real-time data from gittiers.xyz
body:
# GitTierTagger

A Minecraft Fabric mod that displays player tiers from the GitTiers server directly in-game.

## ✨ Features

- **Automatic Tier Display**: See all player tiers next to their names in-game
- **Multi-Category Support**: Shows tiers for Vanilla, Sword, UHC, SMP, Mace, Axe, Pot, and NethOP
- **Real-time Data**: Fetches live tier information from GitTiers API
- **Simple Commands**: Use `/gittiertagger <playername>` to view detailed player stats

## 🎮 Supported Versions

- **Minecraft**: 1.20.4 - 1.21.11
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.15.0+
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric

## 📦 Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)
2. Download GitTierTagger from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/gittiertagger)
3. Place the `.jar` file in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft and enjoy!

## 🔧 Usage

### Automatic Display
Tier tags automatically appear next to player names:
```
🗡HT2 ✦LT3 ❤HT1 ⛨LT4 | PlayerName
```

### Commands
- `/gittiertagger <playername>` - View detailed player statistics
- `/tiertagger <playername>` - Alternative command alias

## 🌐 About GitTiers

GitTiers is a competitive Minecraft PvP server featuring multiple game modes and tier rankings. Visit [gittiers.xyz](https://gittiers.xyz) to learn more.
